messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.

Under the Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011, which body is responsible for the periodic verifications that follow the first one, as covered by the IGEA technical sheet, and within how many days of the request must they be performed?

response.text: Ai sensi del Decreto Ministeriale dell'11 aprile 2011, quale organismo è responsabile delle verifiche periodiche successive alla prima, come previsto dalla scheda tecnica IGEA, e entro quanti giorni dalla richiesta devono essere effettuate?
